title: CSV export doesn't validate admin scope to target shop
summary: Admin token verified but no shop_domain restriction for admin_users. Platform admin can export any shop's customer PII by passing attacker's shop domain.
failure_scenario: Attacker calls GET /api/returns/export?shop=victim.myshopify.com&token=ADMIN_TOKEN and retrieves victim merchant's customer names, emails, phones in CSV.

title: Credential decryption returns corrupted data when key missing
summary: If CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY not set, line 29 executes stored.slice(4) on plaintext credentials, slicing off first 4 chars instead of extracting real encrypted data. Corrupts password.
failure_scenario: Password stored as plaintext before encryption enabled. Later, decrypt function slices off 'enc:' from plaintext, passes corrupted password to Shiprocket API, auth fails silently. Merchant cannot create returns.

title: /api/shopify/stores has conflicting auth policies
summary: Line 1036 requires x-auth-token, but line 1042 calls requireShopAccess which also accepts Shopify Bearer token. Allows Bearer token to bypass x-auth-token requirement.
failure_scenario: Attacker with compromised Shopify idToken calls GET /api/shopify/stores?shop=test.myshopify.com with Authorization: Bearer TOKEN. requireShopAccess validates token and returns store data even without x-auth-token header.
code_snippet:
if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Authentication required' });
if (shop) return requireShopAccess(req, res, next);

title: CSV export team_member check lacks role validation
summary: memberCheck validates session_token + shop_domain exist but doesn't check member.role. Viewer-level team members can export customer PII.
failure_scenario: Team member with 'viewer' role calls export. Query finds team_members record, returns 200 with full customer dataset (emails, phones) that viewer shouldn't access.

title: Decryption hardcodes GCM tag slice bounds without buffer length check
summary: Decryption slices buf.slice(12, 28) for tag without verifying buf.length >= 28. If buffer too short, tag is partial/empty, setAuthTag silently accepts, decipher fails on final().
failure_scenario: Corrupted or truncated encrypted password in DB (28+ bytes expected). Decrypt tries setAuthTag with 16-byte slice that may be wrong. decipher.final() throws, caught silently, returns empty string as password.

title: CSV export doesn't escape double quotes in values
summary: Customer names and other fields wrapped in quotes but internal quotes not escaped. Customer name with quotes breaks CSV format.
failure_scenario: Customer named Alice "Boss" Johnson. CSV line becomes: ID,"Alice "Boss" Johnson" — unpaired quotes break CSV parsing. Excel/parsers may fail or expose adjacent customer data.

title: Export token passed in cleartext URL query parameter
summary: Session token sent as URL query param instead of header. Browser history, proxy logs, and referrer headers expose token in plaintext.
failure_scenario: User clicks export. URL /api/returns/export?...&token=abc123xyz saved in browser history and sync to other devices. Attacker with device access or network logs retrieves token and exports all merchant data.

title: CSV export doesn't call requireShopAccess but reimplements auth
summary: CSV export has custom token validation logic (lines 1450-1456) that duplicates requireShopAccess checks. If requireShopAccess changes, CSV export falls out of sync.
failure_scenario: Future refactor changes requireShopAccess to check new permission field. CSV export still uses old logic, allows unauthorized exports.
code_snippet: Custom auth in export vs middleware in other endpoints
